google-ads.title: What Is a Good Google Ads Conversion Rate for Ecommerce?
google-ads.desc: A "good" Google Ads conversion rate is the rate that produces profitable customers at the traffic cost you are paying.

google-ads.title: What Is a Good Google Ads CTR for Ecommerce?
google-ads.desc: CTR tells you how often an impression becomes a click.

google-ads.title: Why Your Google Ads CPC Suddenly Increased
google-ads.desc: A sudden CPC increase is an auction symptom.

google-ads.title: Google Ads Search Impression Share Explained for Ecommerce
google-ads.desc: Search impression share estimates how often your ads appeared compared with the number of times Google believed they were eligible to appear.

google-ads.title: Lost Impression Share Due to Budget: Should You Increase Spend?
google-ads.desc: "Limited by budget" can feel like Google is telling you to spend more.

google-ads.title: Lost Impression Share Due to Rank: What Should You Fix?
google-ads.desc: When Google reports lost impression share due to rank, your campaign was eligible for searches but did not have enough Ad Rank to win all of the impressions.

google-ads.title: Should Ecommerce Stores Use Broad Match With Smart Bidding?
google-ads.desc: Broad match with automated bidding can discover valuable searches you would never build manually.

google-ads.title: How Many Keywords Should a Google Ads Campaign Have?
google-ads.desc: The correct number of keywords is the number needed to cover meaningful search intent without creating a structure you cannot manage.

google-ads.title: Google Ads Negative Keywords for Ecommerce: What to Look For
google-ads.desc: Negative keywords stop Google from showing ads for searches you deliberately do not want.

google-ads.title: Why Google Ads Spend Increases Without More Sales
google-ads.desc: More Google spend does not automatically create proportionally more demand.

google-ads.title: Google Ads Search Campaign vs Performance Max for Ecommerce
google-ads.desc: Search campaigns and Performance Max solve different parts of Google advertising.

google-ads.title: Should You Run Search Ads if Performance Max Is Already Running?
google-ads.desc: Yes, Search can still have a clear role even when Performance Max is active.

google-ads.title: Google Ads Exact Match Isn't Really Exact: What Ecommerce Advertisers Should Know
google-ads.desc: An exact-match keyword no longer means your ad can appear only when someone types precisely the same characters.

google-ads.title: Should You Separate Brand Traffic From Performance Max?
google-ads.desc: Brand traffic can make Performance Max look more efficient than its true acquisition impact.

google-ads.title: How Much of Performance Max Revenue Comes From Brand Searches?
google-ads.desc: There is no universal percentage.

google-ads.title: How to Tell What Performance Max Is Actually Doing
google-ads.desc: Performance Max is deliberately more automated than traditional Search, which means advertisers often feel they are funding a black box.

google-ads.title: Performance Max vs Standard Shopping: Which Is Better?
google-ads.desc: Performance Max offers more automation and access to broader Google inventory.

google-ads.title: Should You Put All Products in One Performance Max Campaign?
google-ads.desc: Putting every product into one PMax campaign is simple.

google-ads.title: When Should You Split Products Into Multiple PMax Campaigns?
google-ads.desc: Split PMax campaigns when separate control creates a business advantage.

google-ads.title: Best Sellers vs Low Sellers: How Should You Structure Google Shopping?
google-ads.desc: Best sellers deserve attention because they have proven demand.

google-ads.title: Should You Exclude Poor-Performing Products From Performance Max?
google-ads.desc: Sometimes.

google-ads.title: Product Feed Titles: How Much Do They Matter for Google Shopping?
google-ads.desc: Product titles are one of the clearest signals Google has for understanding what you sell.

google-ads.title: Google Shopping Feed Optimization: What Actually Matters?
google-ads.desc: Feed optimization is often sold as a bag of hacks.

google-ads.title: Why Some Shopify Products Never Get Google Shopping Impressions
google-ads.desc: A product can be approved in Merchant Center and still receive almost no Shopping impressions.

google-ads.title: Google Shopping Has High ROAS but Low Volume: Should You Scale?
google-ads.desc: A high ROAS at low spend is encouraging, but it does not prove the same efficiency exists at higher volume.

google-ads.title: Performance Max Spending Mostly on One Product: Is That a Problem?
google-ads.desc: Not necessarily.

google-ads.title: Why Performance Max Stops Spending
google-ads.desc: When Performance Max suddenly spends less, do not start by increasing the budget.

google-ads.title: Performance Max Is Overspending on Branded Searches: What to Do
google-ads.desc: If PMax reports spectacular results because it captures people already searching your brand, the campaign can look more incremental than it really is.

google-ads.title: How Long Should a New Performance Max Campaign Run Before You Judge It?
google-ads.desc: A new PMax campaign needs enough time and conversions to show a pattern, but there is no responsible answer such as "always wait six weeks."

google-ads.title: Performance Max Learning Period: What Should You Avoid Changing?
google-ads.desc: The fastest way to make a new automated campaign impossible to understand is to change several important inputs every few days.

google-ads.title: Performance Max vs Meta Ads for New Product Launches
google-ads.desc: A new product with no search demand behaves very differently from a new product in an established category.

google-ads.title: Why Google Shopping Shows the Wrong Price
google-ads.desc: When a Shopping ad shows a different price from Shopify, treat it as both a conversion problem and a feed-quality problem.

google-ads.title: Merchant Center Feed Issues That Quietly Hurt Performance
google-ads.desc: Not every Merchant Center problem produces a dramatic red "account suspended" warning.

cro-landing-pages.title: What Is a Good Shopify Conversion Rate?
cro-landing-pages.desc: A good Shopify conversion rate is one that supports profitable customer acquisition for your product, traffic mix and margins.

cro-landing-pages.title: How to Improve Shopify Conversion Rate Without Increasing Ad Spend
cro-landing-pages.desc: If traffic stays the same and conversion rate improves, revenue can grow without buying another click.

cro-landing-pages.title: Shopify Product Page Not Converting: What to Check
cro-landing-pages.desc: A product page can fail even when the ad is doing its job.

cro-landing-pages.title: What Should Be Above the Fold on a Shopify Product Page?
cro-landing-pages.desc: The first screen of a product page should help a customer answer one question: "Is this worth looking at?" It does not need to contain every sales argument on the page.

cro-landing-pages.title: Should Shopify Product Pages Show Reviews Near the Top?
cro-landing-pages.desc: For many products, showing a review summary near the top is useful because it answers an immediate trust question: "Have other people bought this, and were they happy?" That does not mean the full review feed belongs above the Add to Cart button.

cro-landing-pages.title: Does Free Shipping Increase Shopify Conversion Rate?
cro-landing-pages.desc: Free shipping can increase conversion because it removes one of ecommerce's most disliked surprises.

cro-landing-pages.title: Free Shipping vs Discount: Which Converts Better?
cro-landing-pages.desc: A discount reduces the price of the product.

cro-landing-pages.title: How Much Does Page Speed Affect Shopify Sales?
cro-landing-pages.desc: Page speed matters because every extra wait gives a visitor another chance to leave, especially on mobile and paid traffic.

cro-landing-pages.title: Shopify Mobile Conversion Rate Lower Than Desktop: Is That Normal?
cro-landing-pages.desc: It is common for mobile and desktop conversion rates to differ, but "mobile is always lower" is not a useful excuse for a poor mobile store.

cro-landing-pages.title: Why Shopify Mobile Traffic Doesn't Convert
cro-landing-pages.desc: When mobile traffic does not convert, start by separating traffic quality from mobile experience.
